name: Claims Adjustment
sourceRefs: Stedi X12 EDI segment reference — stedi.com/edi/x12/segment/CAS: 6 repeating reason/amount/quantity trios (CAS02-04 through CAS17-19), CAS01 is the leading Claim Adjustment Group Code qualifier
Cross-referenced against a general X12 835 web search confirming the same 6-trio structure and the 'first non-zero adjustment goes in the first trio' population rule

PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 835.5010.X221.A1.xml — source for the 5 syntaxRules above (L050607 through L171819): if an amount or quantity is populated in a given trio, that trio's own reason code must be too. Trio 1 (CAS02-04) needs no rule — CAS02/03 are already element-level required, per the flat CAS02-04 group's own maxGroups semantics not needing a repeat-index-0 check the way trios 2-6 do.
